insights.one_liner: JD.com is a giant Chinese e-commerce and logistics group pushing into Europe, with an English-friendly strategy internship in Rotterdam/The Hague.

culture.text: A Chinese technology, retail and supply chain company serving over 700 million customers.
Headquartered in Beijing, with around 62,000 employees.

open.text: Its one open job here, a consulting and strategy internship in Rotterdam and The Hague, doesn't require Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
The internship draws around 48 applicants on LinkedIn.

growth.text: Reported revenue of 462.0 billion renminbi in 2018.
Is close to EU approval for its $2.5 billion takeover of Ceconomy.
Is expanding into home furnishing with a 12,000 square metre home store.

worth_knowing.text: The Ceconomy deal could make JD.com the owner of MediaMarkt in Europe.
